title: Booking a separate cloakroom
titleZh: 另訂放置外套及包包的房間
passage:
Why did you book a smaller room when more people signed up?
A. The smaller room was added to the booking this morning.
B. The afternoon session should be easier to get to.
C. The talk is still in the hall. This room is just for coats and bags.
passageZh:
報名人數變多，為什麼你反而訂了一間比較小的房間？
A. 今天早上才把比較小的房間加進預訂。
B. 下午的場次應該比較容易到達。
C. 演講還是在大廳進行。這間房只放外套和包包。
